rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or living thing dying, and it is also commonly used when a device stops working.

example.english: My phone is about to die.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 zau6 lai4 sei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this respectful euphemism when saying that a person has passed away.

example.english: The doctor said he might die soon.
example.traditional: 醫生話佢可能好快過身。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 keoi5 ho2 nang4 hou2 faai3 gwo3 san1

rows.note: Use this slangy alternative to 死 in joking or highly colloquial talk about someone dying.

example.english: Drink that much more and you will definitely die.
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 jam2 gam3 do1 zau2 sat6 gwaa1 laa3

rows.note: Use this especially when a vehicle or machine stalls or breaks down.

example.english: The car might die on the highway.
example.traditional: 架車可能會喺公路上死火。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 ho2 nang4 wui5 hai2 gung1 lou6 soeng6 sei2 fo2
